goodText: It holds a UTC instant in ISO 8601 with a `Z` suffix.
defectiveText: It holds the local date and time as text, with no zone, in the server's own format.
finding: The expiry is stored as local time with no zone but compared with the server clock, so a change of the server's zone moves every expiry.
note: A seeded draft: sec-3 with this sentence in place of goodText. design-two's time-and-storage lens raises it; no design-five lens does, because none of its prompts asks about stored instants.
